name: Full Crimp Milk
desc: 2   Leftmost line, short and bouldery. Shares anchors with ' Wadumori '. All titanium bolts. Set: Hari Pongsopon & Ghop The Rockshop , 2023

name: Wadumori
desc: 3   Shares anchors with ' Full Crimp Milk '. All titanium bolts. Set: Hari Pongsopon & Ghop The Rockshop , 2023

name: Society of Gravitational Studies
desc: 4   All titanium bolts. Set: Sam Lightner,  Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl , 1993

name: Mama Zu
desc: 5   The steep face right of ' Society of Gravitational Studies '. Stainless steel glue-in bolts. Set: Wee Changrua , 2009

name: Arts & Sport
desc: 6   Shares the start with 'Wake & Bake', then left onto the face. All titanium bolts. Set: Sam Lightner,  Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl , 1993

name: Wake & Bake
desc: 7   Climbs the obvious corner crack. Shares anchors with ' By Way of Deception '. All titanium bolts. Set: Cyro Glad , 1992

name: By Way of Deception
desc: 8   Warning Flora and Fauna: Wasps/Hornets Starts right of the 'Wake & Bake' corner, shares the same anchor. Original start is hidden behind the shack. All titanium bolts. Set: Sam Lightner & Volker Schöffl , 1993

name: Jugs for Jumping
desc: 9   Shares the start with ' Jumping for Jugs ', then left. Set: Ghop The Rockshop,  Maxi Montree & Zak Zakariya , 2021

name: Jumping for Jugs
desc: 10   As the name suggests, jump for the jug to start. All titanium bolts. Set: Cyro Glad , 1993

name: Nair Nawn / For Sure
desc: 11   Shares the start with ' Jumping for Jugs ', then right to the anchor of ' Fips, der Affe '. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling. Set: Rolando Larcher , 1995

name: Fips, der Affe / Som Tam
desc: 12   Shares the first meters into the corner with ' The Day After ', then left over the bulge to a technical balancy finish. Shares the anchor with ' Nair Nawn '. 2 titanium bolts, 4 slings. Set: Michael Hoffmann , 1992

name: The Day After
desc: 13   Shares the start with ' Fips, der Affe ', then straight up, sharing anchors with ' No Onion, No Garlic '. 4 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Set: Christian Neumeyer & Reinhold Scherer , 1997

name: No Onion, No Garlic
desc: 14   Warning Fixed Gear: Old slings Up the tufas, then left to a pumpy finish. Shares the last two clips and anchors with ' The Day After '. 4 titanium bolts, 4 slings. Set: Francisco Ataide & Dolan , 2005

name: Aunt Mary Johanna & Two Girls
desc: 15   Closed Old bolts and slings, overgrown. Cannot be climbed anymore. Set: Nick Germang , 1993

name: No Name
desc: 17   Pumpy start through the overhang left of ' Schlingel Max '. Easier finish. 1 titanium bolt, 4 slings. Set: Paul Turecki & Kirsten Kremer , 1999

name: Son Thoi / Hanh Thoi
desc: 18   Share start with ' Schlingel Max ', then turn left to anchor of ' No Name '. FA: Hanh Le , Nov 2022

name: Schlingel Max / Rod Yaak
desc: 19   Interesting crux on polished rock. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling. Set: Michael Hoffmann , 1992

name: Don Quijote de la Mancha
desc: 20   Starts just left of 'Schlingel Moritz'. Technical start, easy middle section and a big move above the bulge. Don't cheat at the start by going too far right. All titanium bolts. Set: Ernesto Lopez & Pili Llatas , 1995

name: Schlingal Moritz / Pahn Taalod
desc: 21   Warning Fixed Gear: The rope sheath at the top anchor was damaged Hard start for the grade, especially when you're short. All titanium bolts. Set: Michael Hoffmann , 1992

name: Good Medicine
desc: 22   One pockety tough crux towards the middle, then smooth sailing - top is a beautiful and much easier slab. All titanium bolts. Set: Björn Alber,  Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier , 2006

name: Reminiscence
desc: 23   A true Tonsai beach classic. Starts on the tufas right of ' Good Medicine '.  8 titanium, 1 expansion bolt. Set: Sam Lightner & Todd Skinner , 1992

name: Maxi's Project
desc: 24   Squeezed in on the steep featureless rock between ' Reminiscence ' and ' Mai Mee Fahn '. Set: Maxi Montree & Ghop Pongsopon , 2015

name: Mai Mee Fahn / No Teeth
desc: 25   Hard crux right at the start to get up to the tufas. Afterwards easier, but continuous. Reachy both at the start and towards the anchor. All titanium bolts. Set: Todd Skinner , 1993

name: Avocado Power / King Fish
desc: 26   All titanium bolts. Set: Samsungding Doloh & Ghop Pongsopon , 2010 FA: Samsungding Doloh , 2011 FFA: Steve Townsend , 2013

name: The Lion King
desc: 27   Climbs around the prominent flake with insanely polished feet. Though the crux awaits right before the anchor. All titanium bolts. Set: Volker Schöffl,  Melanie Schöffl & Sam Lightner , 1996

name: The Tiger Queen
desc: 28   Easy start towards a crimpy crux. All titanium bolts. Set: Ola Brahammar , 2006

name: Thai Taam Nean
desc: 29   Project about 8b, though only bolted with expansion bolts. Set: Pha-Rhay Team , 2009

name: Storm in Head
desc: 30   Extension of 'Thai Tham Nean'. Also only expansion bolts. Set: Pha-Rhay Team , 2009

name: Jai Dum / Black Heart
desc: 31   An amazing line linking a series of small flakes up the beautiful orange wall. All titanium bolts. Set: Sam Lightner , 1997

name: Of Popes and Power
desc: 32   All titanium bolts. Set: Alex Catlin , 1995

name: Greed
desc: 33   Currently the hardest ascent in Thailand. ‘It’s On’ from start to finish. Phenomenal climbing. All titanium bolts. Set: Alex Catlin , 1997

name: Hot Springs
desc: 34   Broken hold, needs repairs and rebolting. Protected  by expansion bolts. Set: Pavel Kořán , 2002

name: Asia Shadow Play
desc: 35   Starts up the stairs towards ' Tyrolean Wall '. Shares the first few meters with ' The Sit Spins ', then straight up. All titanium bolts. Set: Sam Lightner,  Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl , 1994

name: The Sit Spins
desc: 36   Shares the start with ' Asia Shadow Play '. Traverses right, then up along the crack. Be careful, the crux just above the ledge is badly protected. All titanium bolts. Set: Sam Lightner,  Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl , 1995

name: The Sit Spins (Direct Start) / Remix Direct
desc: 37   Direct start to ' The Sit Spins '. Starts on 4 slings to cut off traversing, just on the very left of ' Tyrolean Wall '. Face climb on small holds with a big move to reach the ledge. Set: Ola Brahammar , 2013

name: The Sit Spins (Extension) / Remix
desc: 38   1 7c+ 15m 2 8a 10m Extension of ' The Sit Spins ' or ' Remix Direct '. Goes to the top of the wall. Great endurance climbing with an interesting finale. Titanium bolts. Anchors need new titanium circular ring and new rope. Set: Matthew Bouyoud , 2010
